newsitem.title: UK: East Midlands faces 1.3 bln stg bid - paper.
newsitem.headline: East Midlands faces 1.3 bln stg bid - paper.

text.p: U.S. energy company Dominion Resources is expected to launch a 1.3 billion pound ($1.97 billion) - or 650 pence a share - bid for East Midlands Electricity Plc on Monday, the Independent on Sunday said.
Dominion said last week it would launch an offer at not much above 608 pence per share. East Midlands subsequently advised shareholders to reject any bid at that level.

The Sunday Telegraph newspaper said even at the higher price, which it puts at 1.25 billion pounds, East Midlands is expected to reject the offer. The group's board is expected to hold out for a price of up to 700 pence a share, the newspaper said.
